## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.9 (U9) — Port Action compilation examples must be complete; jido-07x.10 (U10) — Port Action execution examples must be complete; jido-07x.11 (U11) — Port advanced Action examples must be complete; jido-07x.12 (U12) — Port core basic and workflow examples must be complete; jido-07x.14 (U14) — Port core Plugin and persistence examples must be complete; jido-07x.17 (U17) — Port opt-in external service checks must be complete; jido-07x.18 (U18) — Reconcile offline AI benchmarks must be complete; jido-07x.19 (U19) — Port the AI live provider check must be complete.
- Unblocks: None.

## Files

Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Change `mix.exs`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, and `test/quality/README.md`. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Add named pull request jobs for formatting, warnings, unit tests, Covenant, Reach, authoring, examples, bounded properties, local system, load, and benchmark smoke.
2. Add scheduled or manual extended fuzz, burn-in, and benchmark jobs.
3. Keep service and live jobs manual.
4. Add a change-to-command matrix to `AGENTS.md`.
5. Make README commands match Mix aliases.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each required offline surface has a named CI job.
- [ ] CI runs Covenant and Reach.
- [ ] Live and service checks are not required pull request jobs.
- [ ] Agent guidance names the focused command for each change type.

## Verification

- `mix test.ci`, `mix quality`, `mix covenant.check`, and `mix reach.check --arch --smells` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
